thread:
Mira: Pushed a fresh mock for the "first steps" sidecar — compact panel that slides from the right and surfaces sample templates, a short checklist, and two CTAs. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/first-steps-sidecar :sparkles: Looking for quick takes on copy, focus behavior, and small a11y/copy nits.
Josh: Quick thought 1: if this is a sidecar vs modal, do we make it a focus trap? I'd prefer trap for the first-run so keyboard users don't lose context, but it must be announced properly.
Mira: Current draft is non-trapping to keep users able to explore, but we can test trapping for the very first show.
Val: If non-trapping, please ensure the sidecar sets aria-hidden on underlying main content when open, or uses inert. Otherwise screen readers will still read behind it. Also add aria-modal="true" when trapping.
Ana: Copy: the primary CTA says "Create project" which feels heavy. How about "Try a template" or "Launch a sample". "Try a template" is friendlier IMO.
Priya: Product metric note: recent onboarding experiments show shorter CTAs (<= 2 words) convert better in the EU cohort. Localization team flagged that "Launch" translates poorly in some languages.
LocalizeBot: Reminder: keep primary CTA under 20 chars for German and Portuguese UI constraints.
Josh: Color/contrast: the example primary button uses #1976FF on white; check small text contrast. If small text fails 4.5:1, either darken to #0F57D1 or bump text weight to semibold.
Val: Also add visually-hidden summary for each sample tile: e.g., "Template includes prompts, example dataset, and starter SDK snippet". Keeps SR users from guessing.
Mira: Good call. On ordering: should "Chat assistant" be top? Previous dashboard tests showed "Data explorer" gets more clicks if top, but engagement downstream is lower. Maybe surface popular templates first but include a "Recommended" ribbon.
Priya: We could pick initial ordering via simple heuristic: region + initial selection survey. No ML needed for now.
Ana: UX nit: spacing between tile title and subtitle is tight in narrow widths. Add 6px vertical gap. Also ensure line-clamp for very long project names.
Josh: Keyboard detail: when sidecar closes, focus should return to the toggler button. Also when opening with a keyboard shortcut, focus should land on the first actionable element (first CTA) and announce "Sidecar: first steps" via aria-live polite.
Val: Don't forget to include skip link: "Skip onboarding" as a small text button. Needs clear aria-label "Skip onboarding and close sidecar".
Mira: Telemetry/consent: per legal, EU customers must see consent text. I propose a small inline link in the sidecar footer to a one-time consent modal rather than the sidecar itself (keeps primary flow clean).
Priya: Agree. Also please add analytics events: sidecar_shown, template_selected, template_launched. We'll compare conversion by template position.
LocalizeBot: Note: add context notes for translators explaining what "template" means in this product.
Ana: CTA copy variants to A/B test: ["Try a template", "Launch sample", "Create project"]. I'll prepare test plan and length estimates.
Josh: Example snippet for inert usage I dropped in the doc:
```html
// when sidecar opens
mainContent.setAttribute('inert', '');
sidecar.focus();
// when closing
mainContent.removeAttribute('inert');
```
Val: Accessibility checklist items: focus order, aria-hidden/inert on background, SR descriptions for tiles, contrast checks, skip link, focus return. I'll run the screen-reader pass once mocks updated.
Mira: Action list: Mira -> update figma with sr-only tile text, spacing tweak, and CTA variants. Josh -> prototype focus trap option + inert fallback. Val -> run a11y pass and contrast report. Ana -> test plan + localization length table. Priya -> wire analytics events and pick initial ordering heuristic. LocalizeBot -> add translator notes. Please react :thumbsup: when aligned and I'll schedule a 20m sync on Wed.
Ana: :thumbsup:
